ICS 65.100.10FAD 01New Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for thiodicarb, wettable powder.2. ReferencesThe following standards contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on thisstandard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standardsindicated below:IS No. Title1070 : 1992 Regent grade water (third revision)2771 (Part 1) : 1990 Corrugated fibreboard boxes: Part 1 General requirements (second revision)6940 : 1982 Method of tests for pesticides and their formulations (first revision)8190 (Part 1) : 1988 Requirements for packaging of pesticides: Part 1 Solid pesticides(second revision)10627 : 1983 Methods of sampling for pesticidal formulations16956 : 2018 Thiodicarb, technical - Specification
